name: Fongique Fongique

subject.archetype: Fongique Fongique — Fléau Spore Legendary class spore

loadout.armor_outfit: Living fungal armor growing and pulsating in rhythm with host's heartbeat, toxic spore clouds emanating perpetually from pores across entire surface creating visible green haze, thick mycelial reinforcement visible beneath surface like living root systems, organic matter and fungal growths dripping from every edge with new growth visibly sprouting during combat with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Living spore projection organ on forearm launching concentrated toxic bursts at high velocity like organic projectile weapons, toxic secretion glands in fingertips pulsating and releasing corrosive droplets that sizzle on contact, thick mycelial whip extending from back acting as ranged organic weapon that lashes out to grapple targets The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting all_enemy, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Charging assault fighter lunging into enemy ranks with aggressive momentum and lethal intent. Both arms sweeping outward in devastating horizontal arc with massive devastating wave of negation energy expanding in all directions like dark tsunami rushing across battlefield toward all enemies
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield completely consumed by fungal infestation, thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility creating oppressive green haze, massive mycelial networks pulsating and growing visibly across all surfaces converting terrain into living organism, both ally and enemy positions attacked by spreading infection, massive pulsating sacs bursting and releasing contamination, ground itself alive and hostile with fungal tendrils bursting through without warning
